cgi-pathinfo-nul.reason: Reject a decoded NUL before filesystem/CGI dispatch; do not truncate PATH_INFO.

chunked-bad-size.reason: Malformed HTTP framing returns HTTP 400 and closes, instead of a JSON-RPC parse error inside HTTP 200.

chunked-huge-size.reason: Enforce the original signed-int chunk limit immediately, using the same HTTP 400 contract as malformed framing.

connect.reason: An unsupported-method error closes the connection and says Connection: close.

header-ctrl.reason: Reject NUL/control header bytes before CGI/environment conversion, using the regular malformed-header response.

header-no-colon.reason: Reject an invalid header immediately instead of waiting for the network deadline.

header-obs-fold.reason: Reject obsolete folded headers immediately instead of waiting for the network deadline.

http09.reason: Use a complete HTTP/1.0 error with Connection: close for an unsupported request line.

http12.reason: Reject an unsupported version and advertise the actual connection closure.

http2.reason: Reject an unsupported version and advertise the actual connection closure.

httpx.reason: Reject an invalid version and advertise the actual connection closure.

json-deep-array.reason: Reject a JSON document exceeding the parser depth limit as one parse error, without a partially parsed batch wrapper.

lf-only.reason: Retain recognition of single LF line endings permitted by HTTP recipient robustness; request length and deadline bounds still apply.

long-path-8k.reason: Send a bounded 413 response where possible instead of reproducing a TCP reset; the 4096-byte line limit remains.

lowercase-method.reason: Reject a case-sensitive method mismatch and advertise the actual connection closure.

method-only.reason: Use a complete HTTP/1.0 error with Connection: close for an incomplete request line.

percent-nul.reason: Reject a decoded NUL rather than serving the filename prefix.

pipelined-bad-second.reason: Preserve the successful first response; the malformed second request uses the same complete HTTP/1.0 close error.

raw-space-in-path.reason: Reject an invalid request line and advertise the actual connection closure.

tab-separated.reason: Use a complete HTTP/1.0 error with Connection: close for unsupported request-line separators.

trace.reason: An unsupported-method error closes the connection and says Connection: close.

unknown-method.reason: An unsupported-method error closes the connection and says Connection: close.
